==Usage==
This: 
<pre>
{{Important
|Title=Urist
|Note=This is a human.
|Image=human.png
|Color=#FFFFCC
}}
</pre>

Renders as:
{{Important
|Title=Urist
|Note=This is a human.
|Image=human.png
|Color=#FFFFCC
}}
